$comment: Project-level type-check config for Zed's Pyright-based diagnostics. typeCheckingMode=off silences editor-wide noise: this fork vendors the hanlp tree at repo root, and under the CLI's execution-root resolution any project-mode scan re-resolves `import hanlp` to that copy and loses site-packages, so even `pyright core/analyzer.py` reports 12 phantom errors (3x reportMissingImports and the object/None cascade) that the editor's own resolution does not have. pyrightPath points the editor at the venv's own pyright (same Python 3.10 that runs the tests; the bare binary on PATH falls back to system Python). The repo's core/ type bar: run '.venv/bin/pyright core/' from the repo root, where the project config applies and package resolution matches runtime.
